description: Header file defining the sdap_entity_impl class, which manages SDAP entity mappings, handling SDU processing, and interfacing with TX and RX implementations within the ocudu namespace.

classes.name: sdap_entity_impl
classes.description: Implements the sdap_entity and sdap_tx_sdu_handler interfaces, managing SDAP mappings, handling SDUs, and providing access to TX and RX handlers.

methods.name: get_sdap_rx_pdu_handler
methods.description: Returns the RX PDU handler for a given DRB ID.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Processes an incoming SDU and forwards it to the appropriate TX handler based on QoS flow ID.

methods.name: is_mapped
methods.description: Checks if a QoS flow ID is currently mapped.

methods.name: add_mapping
methods.description: Creates mappings for a QoS flow ID and DRB ID, including TX and RX handlers.

methods.name: remove_mapping
methods.description: Removes mappings associated with a given DRB ID.
